description: List the company's connected MCP servers (observability, tickets, docs, …) that an Owner opened to local agents, and the tools on them you may use. Without `server` it is an overview; pass `server` (the `server` value from the overview) to get each tool's input schema before calling it, and `tool` to narrow to one. `query` keeps tools whose name or description contains every word. `actsAs: "you"` means the tool runs as your own account; `company` means the company's connection.

query.description: Words every listed tool's name or description must contain.

server.description: One server, by its `server` value from the overview.

tool.description: With `server`: one tool by its exact name.

name: anyforge_list_connected_tools
title: List connected tools
